create_biencoder: create a BiEncoder model with question and context encoders for dense passage retrieval
run_biencoder_forward: run the BiEncoder forward pass to get question and context pooled representations
build_document_biencoder: build a DocumentBiEncoder that uses document-level ranking loss instead of passage-level
test_biencoder_get_representation: test the BiEncoder get_representation static method to extract sequence, pooled, and hidden outputs
review_biencoder_load_state: review the BiEncoder load_state method for loading checkpoint state into the model
